role: downstream-facing representation development on the already accessed OSDR development cohort; not final confirmation

architecture.decision: validated K8 organ MoE plus pooled fallback; no secondary axis

representation.masking: identical frozen full score-panel mask and missing-gene mask used by Stage 1 downstream evaluation
representation.pooled_summary: mean 768-dimensional pooled hidden state over observed non-score genes
representation.organ_bottleneck: mean 64-dimensional GELU-activated down-projection of the selected organ residual expert over observed non-score genes
representation.router_features: eight frozen target-hidden input-only organ probabilities

conditions.pooled_hidden_plus_organ_label: pooled_summary concatenated with the revealed eight-way organ one-hot; explanatory upper bound
conditions.true_organ_embedding: pooled_summary plus true-organ bottleneck plus router_features; explanatory upper bound
conditions.blind_router_hard_embedding: pooled_summary plus hard-router-selected bottleneck plus router_features
conditions.blind_router_soft_embedding: pooled_summary plus probability-weighted organ bottleneck plus router_features

evaluation.cohort: same frozen OSDR development cohort; may select output contract but may never confirm it
evaluation.outer_split: five study-grouped folds identical across representations
evaluation.head: elastic-net logistic regression with fail-closed convergence
evaluation.selection_gate: a deployable blind embedding must beat pooled_hidden and both raw expression and fold-fit PCA in all three seeds; otherwise the explicit embedding is not downstream-positive

next_branch.pass: carry the fixed blind embedding contract into the final-refit packaging and prospective confirmation
next_branch.fail: retain organ MoE for reconstruction and use pooled hidden plus raw/PCA baselines for downstream evaluation; do not infer downstream utility from reconstruction
